summary: Frontend-only test of new Overview 'Category Details' panel. All requested checks passed: table renders below 'Income vs Expenses', headers Category/Current month/Last month/Variation, rows match GET /api/analise/month-analysis-comparison/2026-10/2026-09?account=<uuid> exactly (amount=current, lastMonthAmount=last) for Main Account (7 rows) and Savings (6 rows), variation BRL diff + % with red/up for increase, green/down for decrease, neutral for 0 (Housing savings 0,00 (0.0%)). Footer totals correct (Main: 2.732,23 / 6.828,52 / -4.096,29 (60.0%); Savings: 3.097,25 / 4.981,09 / -1.883,84 (37.8%)). Account switch triggers new request with savings uuid and table updates. Subtitle 'October 2026 vs September 2026'. 3 KPI cards visible; three panels each full-width (x=496,w=1216) stacked. No page errors.

issues: When last month is 0 and current > 0 the % shows '100.0%' which is mathematically misleading (e.g. Savings Health +R$ 249,07 (100.0%)); consider showing 'new' or '—'
Per-row Variation badges have no data-testid (only the total has one); consider overview-category-variation-<slug>
